mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_config (id, smtp_host, smtp_port, username, auth_code, ssl_enabled, enabled) VALUES (#{id}, #{smtpHost}, #{smtpPort}, #{username}, #{authCode}, #{sslEnabled}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_config SET smtp_host = #{smtpHost}, smtp_port = #{smtpPort}, username = #{username}, auth_code = #{authCode}, ssl_enabled = #{sslEnabled}, enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
